test_set_and_check_interrupt: test the set_interrupt and is_interrupted functions to verify interrupt flag state changes
test_thread_safety_interrupt: test the set_interrupt function with thread_id parameter to verify cross-thread interrupt signaling
test_skip_tools_when_interrupted: test that AIAgent._execute_tool_calls skips all tool calls and returns cancelled messages when interrupted
test_drain_interrupt_queue: test draining multiple messages from a queue and combining them with newline separators
test_sigterm_trap_killed: test that SIGTERM-resistant processes are escalated to SIGKILL within 2 seconds when interrupted
